sheets.walk: Rows1+2: ONE eight-frame forward combat walk, chronological: guard / front heel lifts / front foot reaches RIGHT / front heel plants wide / weight shifts forward and rear heel rises / rear foot lifts with bent knee / rear foot gathers and toes descend / guard. Rows3+4: ONE eight-frame backward combat walk while facing RIGHT: guard / rear heel lifts / rear foot reaches LEFT / rear toes plant wide / weight shifts rearward / front foot lifts / front foot draws LEFT and lands / guard. Keep torso guarded, weight subtly rising and settling, feet NEVER cross, never turn away. Clearly distinguish support leg and travelling foot in every frame.
sheets.stance: Four separate four-frame sequences, one per ROW. Row1 idle breathing: relaxed ready guard, chest breathes in and shoulders lift slightly, exhale knees settle, ready guard. Row2 crouch: standing ready, knees half bend, deep combat crouch with one knee near ground, settled low crouch. Row3 standing defense: ready guard, forearms close toward face, braced block leaning very slightly away from RIGHT, guard recovers. Row4 crouching defense: low guard, forearms raised over head, deep crouched absorbing block, steady crouch guard. Crouch silhouettes must be visibly only TWO THIRDS standing height with unchanged limb lengths. Feet remain on exact same ground line, no scaling.
sheets.air: Four separate four-frame sequences, one per ROW. Row1 forward jump: crouched takeoff compression / legs extend and arms balance / airborne compact knees tucked / legs extend DOWN ready for landing. Row2 backward jump STILL facing RIGHT: crouched backward lean / push off with knees bending / airborne knees tucked and torso leaning slightly LEFT / legs extend DOWN and body returns upright. Row3 airborne punch: tucked legs guarded / clear fully extended chest-height punching arm / elbow retracts with tucked knees / airborne ready. Row4 airborne kick: chambered knee / clear one leg fully extended horizontally RIGHT, other knee tucked / kicking knee retracts / airborne ready. EVERY pose uses the SAME full standing anatomy scale. Airborne sprites keep hip/root stable; physics in the game supplies vertical travel. No flying superheroes.
sheets.punch: Rows1+2 are one EIGHT-frame lead straight punch or palm sequence: 1 ready guard / 2 shoulder chambers slightly / 3 elbow extends halfway / 4 fist or palm FULLY extends RIGHT at chest height with forward shoulder and planted feet / 5 hips follow through, arm remains extended / 6 elbow folds back / 7 hand returns near jaw / 8 initial guard. Rows3+4 are one EIGHT-frame HEAVY rear-hand strike (swordsman uses katana slash): guard / hips coil backward / rear heel pivots with shoulder beginning to turn / full long rear-arm extension RIGHT, rear shoulder rotated into strike / follow-through with chest rotation / arm retracts / weight settles backward / initial guard. Keep non-striking hand near face. The striking ARM must clearly extend at least one head width beyond idle front hand, no knee attack substituting for punches. Swordsman draws blade and completes a short contained horizontal cut, both hands naturally grip hilt; keep blade entirely in cell.
sheets.kick: Rows1+2 are one EIGHT-frame standing kick: guard / front knee lifts to waist / shin extends halfway RIGHT / fully extended straight side kick at waist height, planted supporting foot pivots / extended leg follows through / knee chambers back toward chest / foot lowers halfway / returns to guard. Rows3+4 are one EIGHT-frame LOW sweep: guard / hips sink deeply / one leg chambers low / kicking leg extends straight RIGHT along ankle height while supporting knee deeply bends / low leg follows through / leg retracts / hips rise / guard. BOTH ARMS remain bent guarding, never become punching arms. Distinct support foot stays on ground. Kicking poses keep same limb lengths, body volume and scale; lower stances are SHORTER.
sheets.special: Four separate four-frame sequences, one per ROW. Row1 projectile action: hands chamber / full release toward RIGHT / extended follow-through / recovery. Row2 rising special: deep crouch load / upward drive and contact pose / airborne apex pose / landing-ready recovery. Row3 rush special: low forward loaded stance / powerful push off with rear leg and forward body lean / extended attack at peak dash / braking guard. Row4 throw: forward grabbing reach / knees bend and hips turn into shoulder throw / arms heave an INVISIBLE opponent over shoulder / stepping recovery. Draw ONLY the fighter, no second person and no projectile or effect. Each special sequence has a clearly readable unique silhouette and natural hip, shoulder, elbow and knee articulation.
sheets.reaction: Four separate four-frame sequences, one per ROW. Row1 head/chest recoil: head jolts LEFT / chest recoils strongly LEFT with knees catching weight / torso rights itself / guard recovered. Row2 body blow: abdomen folds FORWARD to RIGHT / elbow and hands clutch midsection, knees buckle / torso rises / guard recovered. Row3 knockdown: backward off-balance lean / falling backward diagonally LEFT with feet rising / near-horizontal back-first fall / FULLY LYING horizontal on back with knees bent, head at LEFT and feet at RIGHT. Row4 get-up: lying on back / rolls to seated crouch supported by one hand / pushes through knee to squat / full standing guard. Lying poses must be horizontal and lower than standing, no resizing to fill cells. Keep entire body within each cell.
